bounds.startup: same original <=30s absolute startup, clamped to original task end

changed_public_signature: OriginalCircuitPrefreezeSourceV1::from_original_stream(request, evidence, identity, ledger, stream, root, original_root_pidfd, timeout, lifetime, startup_end: Instant) -> Result<Self, CircuitTaskErrorV1>
cold_existing_state: The Material host performs one typed actual Source observation. Completed Source is checked against the same original Cell and Current immediately. Only original ReconciliationRequired (Missing/Pending) waits for the publication event. All other errors are returned.
event_semantics: Private one-time Mutex/Condvar latch belonging to the same concrete task and its once-exported host. No owner lock spans the wait, no polling/retry, spurious wake refuses, late wake refuses.
real_completion_trigger: circuit_task_remote_service::serve calls the private Root observer only after handle(Publish), the original Source binding check and the original Root current check succeed. The observer performs another same-task Source/Cell/current read before waking the latch.
root_registration_and_serve: Unchanged from c66c; the same startup_end supplied by the real supervisor is retained.
wire_semantics: The SAME authenticated HAP stream reverses direction once for a fixed 64-byte HCPRERDY binding/nonce/frame-1 request and exact echo. Client waits before sending Source requests. The hint carries no Source bytes or completion authority.
